For 2026, my top recommendation for a 3-channel dash cam (front + rear + interior) is the VIOFO A329S 3CH. If you want something less expensive, the Vantrue N4 Pro S and 70mai T800 are strong alternatives.

Best 3-channel dash cams — Top 3

1. VIOFO A329S 3CH

Best overall · Premium video quality

$519.99

4K front + 2K rear + 2K interior. Sony STARVIS 2, Wi-Fi 6, 210° cabin coverage and external SSD recording up to 4TB.

Excellent image quality, particularly for license plates and nighttime driving. 
Car and Driver
+1

2. Vantrue N4 Pro S

Best balance of price and performance

$339.99

4K front + 2.5K rear + 1080p interior. Triple Sony STARVIS 2 sensors, infrared cabin night vision and optional LTE connectivity.

Especially good for rideshare drivers who want a compact, integrated cabin camera.

Best for dual-4K front and rear recording

Strong choice when rear-camera clarity is a priority.
